paragraphs.text: Transformers is a booster insert set in the Magic: The Gathering Universes Beyond series that was released with The Brothers' War on November 18, 2022.

This is a cross-over product based on the Transformers franchise, jointly owned by Hasbro & Takara Tomy . The franchise encompasses toys, animation, comic books, video games, and films. Between Summer 2018 and Summer 2020, Wizards of the Coast already had published an original Transformers TCG . Several of the designers of that game were also involved with the 2022 product.

Like all Universes Beyond products, the Transformers cards of this set are only playable in Commander , Legacy , and Vintage formats. However, this is the first time that UB cards are distributed through the release of a premier ( Standard ) Magic: The Gathering set. The cards can be found in Set Boosters , Collector Booster , and Bundles of The Brothers' War . Approximately 10% of Set Boosters will contain a Transformers card.

The set consists of 15 double-faced cards . There are two versions of each card, one regular and one " Shattered Glass Universe " version that depicts the two factions of the franchise in reversed roles. The "Shattered Glass" showcase versions are numbered #16-29 and can only be found in Collector Boosters. There is no Shattered Glass treatment of Arcee, Sharpshooter // Arcee, Acrobatic Coupe . Approximately 12% of Collector Boosters will contain a Shattered Glass treatment card.
Note that these are original designs, and not skinned cards . There are currently no plans to create Universes Within versions of the cards.
The story primarily follows the Autobots and the Decepticons , two alien robot factions at war that can transform into other forms, such as vehicles and animals.
Convert — An alternative term to transform .
More Than Meets the Eye — A way to combine modal double-faced cards with transforming double-faced cards . It is an alternative cost that lets the caster cast the converted side.
Living Metal — An alternative to Crew , it lets Vehicles be creatures on their controller's turn; it appears on the backside of the Transformers.
Returning mechanics are: Bolster , Goad , Monarch , Formidable , Connive , Adapt and Modular .
New counter types include Intel counters .
